title: Legacy App Rescue
summary: Record an Android app before its device disappears.
user: A person preserving an old Android app or game they legally own.
smallest_useful_product: A desktop CLI that inventories user-supplied APKs and an attached Android device, records hashes, signers, SDK requirements, permitted app data, compatibility, and a preservation manifest.
constraints: Never upload or host APKs or app data.
Do not remove DRM, crack, or re-sign third-party apps.
Distinguish preserved metadata from executable compatibility.
